questions.q: Does the leaflet say whether the ball goes in the drum with the clothes or in the detergent drawer?
questions.why: The how-to guide's core step depends on placement, and the data doesn't specify it.

questions.q: What wash temperature range does the packaging recommend (e.g. 30–60°C)?
questions.why: Temperature guidance is essential for a step-by-step usage article and is missing from the data.

questions.q: What does the leaflet advise for heavily soiled loads or stains — pre-treat, extra ball, or a booster?
questions.why: Readers with tough stains need a concrete answer; the data only covers regular loads.

questions.q: Does the packaging list anything to avoid (e.g. wool, silk, delicates, bleach, certain cycles)?
questions.why: Warnings and exclusions are high-value practical facts the article currently lacks.

questions.q: What does the leaflet say about when to replace the ball or how to dispose of it at end of life?
questions.why: The 1,000-wash limit and recyclable claim need practical replacement/disposal detail for the article.
